mentions.name: Hardwood
mentions.description: A new Java parser for the Apache Parquet file format with minimal dependencies and multi-threaded execution. It supports parsing Parquet files with flat and nested schemas, all physical and logical column types, core and advanced encodings, projections, compression, and multi-threading, with decent performance. Planned roadmap items include SIMD support, predicate push-down (bloom filters, statistics), and writer support.
